scope: AR-0 source-fresh inventory of architecture-era feature flags and related control groups; no runtime state is asserted.

disposition_vocabulary.remove: Delete the flag and both alternative architecture branches after the named replacement and observation evidence exist.
disposition_vocabulary.convert: Replace a mutable architecture switch with one mandatory invariant or a typed, non-architectural operational control.
disposition_vocabulary.detach: Keep the accepted adjacent capability, but sever it from cognitive-era maturity gating and give it an independent stable contract and capability-health report.

temporary_control_exception_rule.rule: A temporary control is permitted only for an operational emergency or bounded migration rollback; it MUST NOT select a competing durable architecture or weaken canonical-project, privacy, or authorization invariants.
required_metadata: written expiry release or UTC deadline
safe default and safe active behavior
temporary_control_exception_rule.expiry_behavior: Expiry removes the control and its dormant branch; extension requires a new recorded exception before the prior expiry.

current_exception.reason: Current source labels it an emergency rollback flag, but its false branch returns an explicit empty relevant section rather than a retained alternate retrieval implementation.
current_exception.protected_risk: An AR-6 task-aware delivery regression after cutover must be suppressible without restoring static recent-memory injection or widening project/privacy scope.
current_exception.safe_default: true: the canonical task-aware retrieval path is enabled. Emergency false: emit an explicit empty relevant section and capability-health degradation, never a legacy context dump.
current_exception.activation_criteria: Only an authorized AR-6 incident record with a policy/version correlation may set false; every activation emits capability health and an incident receipt.
current_exception.rollback_criteria: Return true only after the active render-budget policy, bounded packet, exposure idempotency, corpus regression, and installed rollback rehearsal pass.
metrics: task-aware packet delivery and explicit-empty-result rate
exposure idempotency and privacy-leakage corpus results
capability-health degraded duration and incident count
current_exception.both_branch_test: T074 exercises true canonical retrieval and false explicit-empty emergency behavior with identical canonical-project/privacy validation and no static-context fallback.
current_exception.expiry_release: AR-6 installed retrieval cutover; no later than AR-7 contraction
current_exception.required_replacement_evidence: Task-aware retrieval, active render-budget declaration, bounded packet, exposure recording, both-branch test, rollback rehearsal, and installed observation all pass before deleting the control.

defaults.ENGRAM_VNEXT_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true
defaults.ENGRAM_VNEXT_F_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: The two gates are not a single master/subfeature pair in current source: ENGRAM_VNEXT_F_ENABLED independently activates privacy-scope filtering and candidate routing when ENGRAM_VNEXT_ENABLED is false.
Readers are mixed per request and startup/reporting paths; the /api/flags env reporter recognizes only exact lowercase true.
The flag-off contract intentionally preserves older retrieval and write behavior, so each flag selects competing architecture rather than capability health.
groups.owner: AR-4 durable-evidence and AR-6 task-aware-retrieval owners; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-4 durable intake and AR-6 one task-aware retrieval path replace the selected branches; AR-7 deletes flags, readers, schemas, docs, tests, mocks, routes, and UI claims together.

defaults.parser: FlagConfig accepts true, 1, or yes after trim/lowercase; a disabled master suppresses every subsystem

semantic_divergence: The V7 config snapshot is captured when LoadFlagConfigFromEnv is called, while some direct readers such as session-start meta-summary use exact lowercase true at request time.
Direct S2 readers do not use FlagConfig's true/1/yes parser, so an environment value of 1 or yes has inconsistent effective behavior across the same V7 group.
Master and milestone gates select cognitive subsystem implementations instead of reporting provider or operational health.
groups.owner: AR-5 reconciliation-and-policy owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: Preserve only accepted state, policy, telemetry, and outcome contracts through their authoritative AR-4 to AR-6 records; remove V7 implementation-selection gates after their replacement evidence is installed and observed.

defaults.ENGRAM_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: One env switch controls process startup of the sleep cycle, tool advertisement, write shape, recall filtering, and asynchronous access/stability mutation.
The same recall input name tier_filter has different lifecycle and hybrid-retrieval meanings, making flag state part of API semantics rather than an operational capability state.
groups.owner: AR-5 knowledge-reconciliation owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-5 makes revision and lifecycle history authoritative; AR-7 removes the lifecycle fork only after compatibility, zero-drift observation, and rollback evidence.

defaults.ENGRAM_CRYSTALLIZATION_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: The flag gates transcript persistence and later dream extraction together, so provider availability and a timer determine whether evidence exists at all.
The session-end route can still acknowledge with 202 while this gate prevents transcript persistence, which diverges from durable-acceptance semantics.
groups.owner: AR-4 durable session-evidence owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-4 durably accepts evidence before provider work and gives it a terminal processing state; AR-7 removes the transcript/dream gate and its candidate-only branch.

defaults.ENGRAM_ADAPTIVE_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: The HTTP routes remain registered but return disabled, while MCP tool advertisement removes get_memory_brief entirely; availability semantics therefore differ by transport.
The gate couples unrelated segmentation, correction, reinjection, extraction, and brief retrieval paths rather than reporting a named provider capability.
groups.owner: AR-6 task-aware-retrieval owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-6 supplies one query-driven retrieval and exposure workflow; AR-7 removes this maturity gate and retires unsupported adaptive branches or moves accepted operational dependencies behind typed capability health.

defaults.ENGRAM_RULE_ARBITER_ENABLED: false and effective only with governance enabled
defaults.typed_limits: 20 candidate batch, 8000 ms timeout, 300 s interval, 8 kernel rules, 12 contextual rules, 4800 rendered characters, and best-effort telemetry true

semantic_divergence: Governance and arbiter treat only true or 1 as enabled; router uses strconv.ParseBool; governance intent also performs a raw env read before consulting Config.
The three booleans choose direct rule writes versus candidate routing and direct session-start reads versus router reads, so they are architecture selectors.
The numeric limits and telemetry setting are operational budgets, not alternate architectures; they require conversion to typed policy/retrieval budgets after the selector booleans are removed.
groups.owner: AR-5 policy-and-reconciliation owner; AR-6 retrieval-delivery owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-5 makes policy a stricter knowledge class with one authoritative decision path; remove the three selector booleans and retain only explicitly typed, owned, bounded budgets with capability-health observation.

defaults.ENGRAM_INJECT_UNIFIED: true; settings and environment can override it
defaults.ENGRAM_INJECTION_TOP_K: 100 unless a positive integer environment value is supplied

semantic_divergence: The unified true branch derives a task-like query and calls RetrieveRelevant; false does not restore a full legacy path and instead returns an empty relevant section while preserving the HTTP shape.
ENGRAM_INJECT_UNIFIED is writable through PATCH /api/config while most maturity switches are env-only, and its source comment still says it should have been removed after two release cycles.
Top-K and injection limits are mixed between direct environment reads and Config fields, so the same delivery behavior is governed by two control planes.
groups.owner: AR-6 retrieval-delivery owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.temporary_control_exception: Only ENGRAM_INJECT_UNIFIED may remain temporarily under this inventory's temporary-control exception rule; its current false branch is safe degradation, not a supported alternate architecture.
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-6 task-aware delivery supplies bounded packets and exposure records; after installed rollback and observation evidence, delete the unified selector and obsolete injection tuning that belongs only to the retired path.

defaults.ENGRAM_CONTINUITY_SLOT_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true; declared effective only with ENGRAM_VNEXT_ENABLED=true

semantic_divergence: The MCP handler correctly requires both continuity and VNext, but session-start checks the continuity env directly only inside its VNext branch; the control is therefore split across tool and gRPC selection paths.
It reserves a memory before session-start scoring, which is static context assembly rather than task-aware retrieval.
groups.owner: AR-6 task-aware-retrieval owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-6 limits session start to universal policy/state and moves relevance selection to task-aware retrieval; AR-7 removes the designated-memory selection flag and its tool/route/UI claims after migration and rollback evidence.

defaults.ENGRAM_TEMPORAL_TRUTH_ENABLED: false in .env.example; HTTP bootstrap accepts true or 1 after trim, while other readers may use their own helper

semantic_divergence: The HTTP surface snapshots the flag at service startup and rejects disabled calls with 503; the MCP helper reads the environment directly, so their effective timing can diverge.
A temporal truth read/admission surface is outside the recovery's broad temporal-interface scope and must not be silently treated as the knowledge authority.
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-7 makes an explicit retained-adjacent or deletion decision. If retained, its enablement becomes independently versioned capability health with named source, consumer, and no authority over canonical knowledge or retrieval.

defaults.ENGRAM_GRAPH_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: REST graph handlers use a startup snapshot while MCP tool advertisement reads the environment directly, so a changed environment can present inconsistent HTTP and MCP capability state until restart.
The UI presents graph availability from /api/flags, but the source flag gates graph write/read surfaces and does not establish a graph-first knowledge authority.
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-7 classifies graph as a rebuildable projection or retires it. If retained, move it to an independently owned adjacent capability contract with rebuild source, health denominator, and no independent knowledge-write authority.

defaults.ENGRAM_CODE_INTEL_ENABLED: false when unset or any value other than exact lowercase true

semantic_divergence: The same switch separately controls daemon module registration, server store wiring, MCP advertisement, and per-call errors; all require exact lowercase true.
Code intelligence is an accepted adjacent primitive, but the flag currently treats it as a cognitive-era maturity feature with flag-off tool-surface byte identity.
groups.owner: AR-3 adjacent-capability identity owner; AR-7 contraction owner
groups.replacement_boundary: AR-3 applies canonical identity to this project-scoped adjacent capability. AR-7 removes maturity gating after its supported contract has independent capability health, compatibility proof, and no reliance on legacy selector identity.

semantic_divergence: Source defaults to enforcement enabled, while the architecture configuration document states false; this is a source/documentation contradiction on a security boundary.
The boolean can be changed through settings, environment, and PATCH /api/config, allowing callers to choose whether source/project scope constrains store and edit operations.
AR canonical identity requires scope resolution before every project-scoped operation, so mutable enforcement is incompatible with the target invariant.
groups.replacement_boundary: Replace the mutable flag with unconditional canonical-project resolution and fail-closed authorization. Remove settings, environment, PATCH, runtime-flag, documentation, and test paths that permit disabling source/project enforcement; AR-7 verifies no former toggle consumer remains.

entry_closure_contract.zero_evidence_rule: A target release, calendar date, empty denominator, or silent absence never closes an entry.
